title: Connection Strategy: HTTP/1.1 Sharding vs HTTP/3 QUIC
description: Compare legacy domain-sharded HTTP/1.1 pools against single-origin QUIC stream multiplexing.

before.label: HTTP/1.1 Domain Sharding (6 TCP Sockets/Host)
before.previewNote: Each stalled request blocks every queued asset behind it on that socket.

after.label: HTTP/3 Single-Origin QUIC Streams
after.previewNote: A lost UDP packet only stalls its own stream; sibling CSS and JS continue arriving.
